function.name: list_help_todos
function.description: List todos containing 'help' case-insensitive from a CSV file. Reads the CSV at file_path and prints each row where the 'todo' field includes 'help' (case-insensitive). Returns True if any such todos are printed, False otherwise. Returns False if the file cannot be found.

file_path.description: The path to the CSV file containing todos.
